name: Keeva
source:
A contestant in the first round of the AT Resonara Audition and a music school day student. She and Rein are childhood friends and kindred souls. She is a bright and cheerful girl who treasures everything before her. Beneath her sunny exterior lies a strong-willed, calm, and deeply composed side.

[From in-game bio]
